purpose: the record that makes a root auditable: what was read, what was reconstructed, what was preserved, what was lost, and what the human annotation is allowed to influence.

pipeline.name: external item read
pipeline.produces: raw item bytes + content_hash + license record

pipeline.name: canonical reconstruction
pipeline.produces: W_canonical in the v2 fact language
pipeline.constraint: only AT, CONNECTED, BLOCKED, HOLDS, CONTAINS, STATE, REL plus temporal qualifiers

pipeline.name: reconstruction witness
pipeline.constraint: must re-derive without consulting the source item

pipeline.name: deterministic derivation
pipeline.produces: y_derived = f(W_canonical) via the pinned v2 algebra

pipeline.name: BANK label
pipeline.produces: the canonical target, with y_human carried alongside as a check

required_fields.root_id: stable identifier, unique across the bank
required_fields.content_hash: sha256 of the exact bytes read
required_fields.license_record_ref: pointer into the source ledger; a root without this is a G14-V3 failure
required_fields.fact_language_conformance: list of predicates used, each of which must be one of the seven permitted
required_fields.preserved_semantics: explicit list of what the reconstruction retains
required_fields.changed_semantics: explicit list of what it alters, drops, or approximates
required_fields.unreconstructable_elements: explicit list of source structure that could NOT be represented, with a reason for each
required_fields.reconstruction_confidence: EXACT | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW, with the basis stated
required_fields.verifier_receipt: pointer to the receipt produced by re-deriving the witness

hard_prohibitions: human_annotation_role must never be LABEL or TRUTH
a PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION may not claim a witness for facts it could not reconstruct
unreconstructable_elements may not be left empty merely to look complete

EXACT_RECONSTRUCTION.definition: every semantically load-bearing element of the source item is representable in the v2 fact language and was reconstructed, with no approximation

PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION.definition: some load-bearing elements are representable and were reconstructed; others are recorded in unreconstructable_elements
PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION.may_contribute: renderer and natural-language material, only where preserved semantics are explicitly bounded
PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION.must_not: supply canonical targets, or present an approximate fact as a witnessed one
PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION.rationale: a partial reconstruction is honest about its boundary, which is strictly better than a confident reconstruction that quietly invented structure

REJECTED_RECONSTRUCTION.definition: the item's structure does not fit the v2 fact language, or the reconstruction cannot be witnessed at all
REJECTED_RECONSTRUCTION.why_record_it: rejection rates per source are themselves a source-selection signal; a source rejected at 90% is a different fact about that source than one never tried

descendant_record.note: one per generated child, per the lineage invariant

required_fields.root_id: exactly one; a descendant with zero or many roots is a G-LINEAGE failure
required_fields.transformation: the declared named transformation, e.g. P5 or support-minus
required_fields.verifier_receipt: pointer to the receipt that re-derives this descendant's targets
required_fields.capability_axes: structural annotation over the 10 frozen axes
required_fields.root_disposition_inherited: the root's reconstruction_disposition, carried so a partial root's descendants cannot silently claim target supervision

descendant_record.invariant: a descendant of a PARTIAL or REJECTED root may not supply canonical target supervision

capability_axes.annotation: every root and every descendant carries a structural annotation, not a free-text description
capability_axes.purpose: enables constructed curricula such as support -> support+conflict -> support+conflict+transition, instead of shuffling a large row count and hoping

also_reported: the specific target families each source can and cannot support
agreement_reporting.unresolved_cases: where a human annotation is itself ambiguous, the case is recorded as ANNOTATION_AMBIGUOUS rather than counted as a derivation failure
agreement_reporting.why: separating a bad reconstruction from an ambiguous annotation is what makes the agreement rate actionable as a source-selection signal

G-V1-EXCLUSION: no root carries a v1 world_id or v1 world_hash

open_items.item: reconstruction-yield probe has not been run
open_items.note: until it reports, every yield claim in the program is an assumption. It is cheap: reconstruct a bounded sample per candidate source and report the disposition mix.
